text_block_list.name: Homestay Exchange Student
text_block_list.text:
Fantastic!
This view is straight out of a manga!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm so glad you liked it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, Satono Diamond was showing an exchange student staying at her family's home around town.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Grass-san recommending it as a "popular spot for foreign manga fans"!
Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad I could be of help.
It was well worth coming along.

text_block_list.name: Homestay Exchange Student
text_block_list.text: “—Dia! I wanna try wearing a kimono! I wanna take photos in a kimono!”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A kimono... Um,
do you have a rental reservation?

text_block_list.name: Homestay Exchange Student
text_block_list.text: No, can I not wear it without a reservation?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: If only we could find a shop willing to take us without a reservation, though...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If it is a full kimono rather than a yukata... it might be a bit difficult
to gather the entire set, including the undergarments, at this point.

text_block_list.name: Homestay Exchange Student
text_block_list.text:
"Oh…… Wearing a kimono is quite an ordeal, isn't it……?
Is that why nobody's wearing one?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, not very often in daily life.
It seems the difficulty in putting it on
and moving around are the main drawbacks.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, people do wear them during festivals and such.
They are truly gorgeous and elegant—the kimono
is truly the crystallization of Japanese tradition.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"So with fewer people wearing them,
I also feel a sense of sadness."

text_block_list.name: Homestay Exchange Student
text_block_list.text: ...I see... What a pity.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...What should I do? I went and disappointed them.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (Still... is it really true that kimonos aren't worn much anymore? Just recently on Umastagram, there was a photo of a kimono—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I know! I just thought of something great♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the arcade,
I spotted Satono Diamond and Grass Wonder...
――!!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
We're about to take purikura photos♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This? Well, actually—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, that's what happened.
Even so, I don't believe our traditions are dying out.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I mean, look! There are so many photos of people in kimonos on Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I wear it with ribbons instead of an obi,
and pair it with a skirt!"

text_block_list.name: Homestay Exchange Student
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Dia say that reminded me!
They wear customized outfits in manga too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Kimono designs are sometimes incorporated
into racewear and live stage outfits, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"They're easy to wear and easy to move in.
Any potential concerns have been covered by our alterations!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's not that people lost interest in kimonos.
They're updating them with modern styles and enjoying them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“—That is one modern way to enjoy Japanese kimono.
So we decided to take a modern commemorative photo
in a modern kimono style♪”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's why the international students are wearing kimono-like outfits. But if so, why...
choice_data_list: Grass Wonder doesn't really seem like the kimono type...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Um... While we were looking for outfits, she asked me to wear this one...

text_block_list.name: Homestay Exchange Student
text_block_list.text:
She looks like an in-game healer!
Cool Japan! I wanna take a photo together!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Apparently so.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's take the photo soon...
Ah, how should we decorate it?
It looks like there are doodles and stamps...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Please choose for me, Trainer!
choice_data_list: How about a cherry blossom stamp?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's all write
whatever we want!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, the doodle-filled photo strips were complete.
It was as if they had captured
all the lively excitement of today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Photo sticker booths are taken for granted now, but... they're really just the modern evolution of commemorative photos, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps we carry on traditions
by adapting them to fit the times."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Cherry blossoms...? But the ornament on my ear is a camellia...
choice_data_list: Imagine craning your neck, eagerly awaiting the arrival of spring

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Is that a play on winter camellias and turtles?
Ufufu, how delightfully refined."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Putting cherry blossoms into a winter poem to express a yearning for spring...
It's a common technique used in waka poetry."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I see! That means Japanese tradition has truly taken root in you, Trainer♪
